setup_logging_with_tensorboard: use LoggingMixin.initial_setup to configure logging handlers, file output, and Tensorboard for a training run
count_model_parameters: use LoggingMixin.count_parameters to count total parameters and layers in a PyTorch model
create_tensorboard_handler: create a TensorboardHandler to route Python logging messages into Tensorboard text summaries
log_losses_to_tensorboard: use LoggingMixin.add_losses_to_tensorboard to write training or test loss scalars to Tensorboard
export_tensorboard_scalars: use LoggingMixin.postrun to export Tensorboard scalar data to JSON and close the writer
